description: Browse congressional committees and their legislation, reports, and nominations. Use 'list' (with optional 'filter' for name→code resolution) to discover committee codes — the systemCode on each row, such as 'hsju00' or the historical 'n79043125' — then 'get' or drill into 'bills', 'reports', or 'nominations' ('nominations' is Senate-only). 'get' and sub-resources only need committeeCode: the chamber is read from the code's prefix, or from the committee roster when the prefix names no chamber or one that does not hold the code; pass chamber explicitly to override. 'bills' and 'reports' take fromDateTime/toDateTime, a window on the dates Congress.gov updated each row: a row with any update inside the window matches, so a window returns rows added in it plus older rows touched in it. Congress.gov lists a committee's bills roughly from least to most recently updated; 'bills' defaults to order='recent', which reverses that list, and order='oldest' keeps it. Upstream omits bill titles from the 'bills' sub-resource — rows carry only {congress, type, number, actionDate, relationshipType, updateDate, url}; chain 'congressgov_bill_lookup get' per row to retrieve titles and policy area.

chamber.description: Chamber filter for 'list'. For 'get' and sub-resources, the committee's chamber, inferred when omitted; set it to resolve a committee name given as committeeCode among that chamber's committees only.

committeeCode.description: Committee system code: the systemCode of a 'list' row, e.g. 'hsju00' or 'n79043125', matched case-insensitively. Required for 'get' and sub-resources; 'list' refuses it. Any other value with a letter or digit is treated as a committee name and resolved automatically — single-word names ('Judiciary') included — or use operation:'list' with filter to browse.

congress.description: Congress number, for 'list' only — Congress.gov offers no congress filter on a committee's bills, reports, or nominations.

filter.description: Filter committee-list results by name (e.g., 'transportation', 'armed services'), for 'list' only; fuzzy-matched rows are labeled approximate.

fromDateTime.description: Start of the update-date window for 'bills' and 'reports' (ISO 8601, e.g. 2025-03-01T00:00:00Z): a row matches when Congress.gov updated it at any time inside the window, so older rows touched in the window match too, and each matched row carries an updateDate from inside the window rather than its latest. Ignored by 'list', 'get', and 'nominations'.

order.description: Row order for the 'bills' sub-resource. Congress.gov lists a committee's bills roughly from least to most recently updated: 'recent' (default) reverses that list, so the rows it lists last come first, and 'oldest' keeps it. Ignored by other operations.

toDateTime.description: End of the update-date window for 'bills' and 'reports' (ISO 8601). Same semantics as fromDateTime. Ignored by 'list', 'get', and 'nominations'.

name: congressgov_committee_lookup

data.description: Result rows. Per-tool item shape is rendered in the markdown body.

items.description: Upstream JSON record. Per-tool item shape is rendered in the markdown body.

effectiveQuery.description: The browse scope and applied filters.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: A requested bill, member, committee, report, vote, or nomination does not exist in Congress.gov. `rate_limited`: A process-local attempt budget or the shared upstream credential/IP quota was reached; upstream hourly limits vary and DEMO_KEY also has a daily quota. On a Senate vote the LIS feed could not answer, Voteview answering HTTP 429 is reported the same way. `invalid_request`: Congress.gov rejected the request as malformed — a bad date range or an identifier with an unexpected shape. `api_key_rejected`: The api.data.gov gateway rejected the server's configured CONGRESS_API_KEY (missing, invalid, disabled, unauthorized, or unverified); the gateway code is in data.upstreamCode. No change to the call's arguments can fix it. `upstream_error`: Congress.gov returned an unexpected error (5xx or another non-2xx status) or could not be reached, or a Senate vote could be read from neither the Senate LIS feed nor its Voteview fallback (before the 101st Congress there is no fallback, and there a senate.gov HTTP 403 refusal carries retryable: false). `upstream_timeout`: A Congress.gov request or a congress.gov document fetch timed out or returned an HTTP timeout response, or the call's upstream requests could not finish inside its 50-second budget. `incompatible_identity`: A list operation carries an entity identifier that only a detail operation uses. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when results are empty, a page is past the end, or a caveat applies.

pagination.description: Pagination metadata: total count and next offset.

count.description: Total result count across all pages.

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass for the next page, or null when there are no more pages.
